facts.text: Melanie expressed admiration for Caroline's efforts in creating a family for children who need one.

evidence.quote: You're doing something amazing! Creating a family for those kids is so lovely.
Thanks, Melanie! Your kind words really mean a lot.

facts.text: Caroline acknowledged Melanie's support and expressed her commitment to providing a safe and loving home for the children.

evidence.quote: I'll do my best to make sure these kids have a safe and loving home.
No doubts, Caroline. You have such a caring heart - they'll get all the love and stability they need!

facts.text: Caroline mentioned her excitement about the adoption process and her willingness to take on the challenge of being a single parent.

evidence.quote: I'm thrilled to make a family for kids who need one. It'll be tough as a single parent, but I'm up for the challenge!
